description.text: The second e-Card set, released on 15 January 2003 and made from two Japanese sets, The Town on No Map and Wind from the Sea. It has 186 cards: 147 in the main numbering, 32 holos numbered H1 to H32, three Crystal Pokémon beyond the numbering (Kingdra, Lugia and Nidoking), and Golduck, Drowzee, Mr. Mime and Porygon in an a and a b version with different e-Reader data. Its holos have their own numbers because the e-Reader can't read a foil dot code, so every holo also comes as a non-holo rare. Its theme decks were Abyss and Rock Garden.
